title: Escape the maze
description:
Find the shortest way out of a grid maze with breadth-first search.

```
#########
#S..#...#
#.#.#.#.#
#.#...#E#
#########
shortest path: 12 steps
#########
#S**#***#
#.#*#*#*#
#.#***#E#
#########
```
hints: A `std::vector<std::vector<int>> dist` set to -1 marks unvisited cells; BFS sets `dist` of each neighbour to one more (lesson 5.01).
Walk back from `E` with the "came from" grid and put `*` on every cell except `S` and `E`.
requirements: BFS from `S` over `.` cells in four directions; `#` is a wall.
Remember where each cell was reached from, and draw the path with `*`.
Print `no way out` if `E` cannot be reached.
stretch: Allow diagonal moves, and compare the path lengths.
